corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The examples target an oversimplified proportionality between ordinary neural activity and consciousness, bringing concrete human and plant phenomena into direct contact with the central consciousness-first bridge. Principal limitation: Decision, memory, adaptive behavior, phenomenal consciousness, reduced neural tissue, and absent material processing are treated too interchangeably, while verification details and alternative distributed-biological explanations remain substantially compressed. Live burden: Jones must establish that the cited systems possess consciousness, distinguish reduced or unconventional processing from no material processing, and show why these cases favor idealism over physical realization through different architectures. Locked score: The mixed band reflects meaningful empirical relevance, recoverable examples, and a legitimate challenge to simplistic brain models, counterbalanced by materially unstable terminology, overstated evidential calibration, limited rival analysis, and an inferential gap between unusual biological function and consciousness independent of material mechanisms.

corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The argument combines psychedelic phenomenology with attention-related neural plasticity to challenge simplistic activity-production models and supplies an empirically oriented line of support for the central consciousness-first bridge. Principal limitation: Reduced activity in selected measures can accompany altered network organization, while top-down psychological description remains compatible with materially implemented causation and therefore does not independently identify nonphysical or consciousness-first ontology. Live burden: Jones must specify the neural measures, rule out reorganized physical processing, and derive contrasting predictions by which idealist mental causation outperforms physicalist accounts of attention, training, and psychedelic experience. Locked score: The competent band recognizes coherent relevance, concrete evidential direction, and appropriately qualified plausibility, while recording slightly overstated warrant, partly unstable use of top-down causation, incomplete alternative testing, and a substantial bridge from explanatory level to metaphysical priority.
